verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's documented browser capability is a request/response scraping API. Headless browsers render JavaScript, and scripted JS scenarios (click, fill, scroll) run before the HTML is returned. Nothing in the evidence shows a managed remote browser session that a developer can drive interactively or manually. Scripted pre-return instructions are an adjacent feature, not an interactive browser sandbox.

support.subject: As a developer, I can access a managed remote browser sandbox for interactive, manual browsing workflows
